comment: The Haro v0.24 conformance floor, written BEFORE the court that passes it (the W discipline: fixtures first, prose second). v0.24 grows v0.23 by the two articles it refused by name (ZC3 of the constitution plane, on the author's 'Start ZC3', 2026-11-02): visible_state (3) is judged THROUGH the three access paths a language already declares -- every declaration kind is told by the NARRATE (SAYS), asked by the ASK (FROM) or published by the WORLD (PUBLISH), and a kind none reaches is hidden state; organizational_sovereignty (5) is judged THROUGH the zones a world declares -- the CONSTITUTION names the ZONE kind, its SOVEREIGN seat (who holds it: a word of a MENU of organizations, or a text, never optional) and its MOVEMENT seat (the declared kind, a flow, every record enters it through; never optional). The forged court cites article:5 where a zone's holder or entry is missing or dangling (the sentence cases), and keeps the gate's events as an audit chain it answers as a query (the `audit` verb) under article 3. Every v0.23 declaration still passes: v0.24 refuses nothing v0.23 accepted (A4 is v0.23's A1, unchanged); v0.23's R11 and R12, which pinned 'no mechanism yet', now pin the first refusal of each mechanism and were amended so, recorded in v24/GRAMMAR.md. Rejects carry the fragment the refusal must contain.

accepts.name: a world under all six articles: every kind told, a REFINE with floors, a zone with a holder and an entry
accepts.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE bank AS (VERSION "0.24", GRAMMAR "0.24", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".bank") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE MENU holders AS (WORDS [the_bank, the_clearing_house]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION account AS (VERB "ACCOUNT", SEATS [holder: text, ceiling: number]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION flow AS (VERB "FLOW", SEATS []) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION vault AS (VERB "VAULT", SEATS [held_by: holders, entered_through: flow]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE REFUSAL unknown_verb AS (MESSAGE "The verb set is closed", CODE "UNKNOWN_VERB") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE REFINE bank AS (POINTS [account.ceiling: knob], FLOOR [account.ceiling: external]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE NARRATE voice AS (SAYS [account: "{name} is held by {holder} up to {ceiling}.", flow: "{name} is a flow.", vault: "{name} is held by {held_by}, entered through {entered_through}."], REFUSES "Stopped at line {line}: {message} ({cites})") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE CONSTITUTION charter AS (ARTICLES [explainability, reversibility, visible_state, predictable_authority, organizational_sovereignty, trust_hierarchy], ZONE vault, SOVEREIGN held_by, MOVEMENT entered_through) RATIONALE "the whole constitution"

accepts.name: Art. 3 through the ASK: a kind the voice does not tell is reached when a question is asked of it
accepts.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE bank AS (VERSION "0.24", GRAMMAR "0.24", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".bank") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION account AS (VERB "ACCOUNT", SEATS [holder: text, ceiling: number]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION flow AS (VERB "FLOW", SEATS []) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE NARRATE voice AS (SAYS [account: "{name} is held by {holder}."]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE ASK questions AS (FROM [flow]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE CONSTITUTION charter AS (ARTICLES [visible_state]) RATIONALE "x"

accepts.name: Art. 3 through the WORLD: a kind the voice does not tell is reached when the world publishes it
accepts.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE bank AS (VERSION "0.24", GRAMMAR "0.24", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".bank") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION account AS (VERB "ACCOUNT", SEATS [holder: text, ceiling: number]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION flow AS (VERB "FLOW", SEATS []) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE NARRATE voice AS (SAYS [account: "{name} is held by {holder}."]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE WORLD w AS (PUBLISH [flow: flow]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE CONSTITUTION charter AS (ARTICLES [visible_state]) RATIONALE "x"

accepts.name: a v0.23 declaration is a v0.24 declaration: v0.23's A1, unchanged -- under four articles, an untold kind is nobody's concern
accepts.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE bank AS (VERSION "0.23", GRAMMAR "0.23", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".bank") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION account AS (VERB "ACCOUNT", SEATS [holder: text, ceiling: number]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION limit AS (VERB "LIMIT", SEATS [on: account, daily: number, rule: text, message: text]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE CONSTRAINT one_limit_per_account AS (ON limit, WHEN "earlier limit where on = this.on", MESSAGE "LIMIT {name} and {other} both stand on {on}: one limit an account", CODE "ONE_LIMIT") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE REFUSAL unknown_verb AS (MESSAGE "The verb set is closed", CODE "UNKNOWN_VERB") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE REFINE bank AS (POINTS [account.ceiling: knob, limit.daily: knob, limit.rule: policy, limit.message: field], FLOOR [account.ceiling: external, limit.daily: trusted, limit.rule: trusted, limit.message: llm]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE NARRATE voice AS (SAYS [account: "{name} is held by {holder} up to {ceiling}."], REFUSES "Stopped at line {line}: {message} ({cites})") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE CONSTITUTION charter AS (ARTICLES [explainability, reversibility, predictable_authority, trust_hierarchy]) RATIONALE "the four articles Haro v0.23 judges, in Zin's order"

accepts.name: Art. 5 with a text-typed holder: a zone held by a name written out is held

DEFINE CONSTITUTION charter AS (ARTICLES [organizational_sovereignty], ZONE vault, SOVEREIGN held_by, MOVEMENT entered_through) RATIONALE "x"

rejects.refusal: Art. 5 organizational_sovereignty: 'bank' names no ZONE -- a world under sovereignty says which of its kinds holds its data (ZONE), who holds each (SOVEREIGN) and through which declared flow a record enters it (MOVEMENT)
